text:
The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run 4 kilometres, the Dunmarrow Canal Authority confirmed on 14 March 2031, when it formally announced the route and length.

I was in the public gallery as Marisol Ketteridge, the Authority's Chief Engineer, presented the Feasibility and Route Report (Revision C) to the board. She told members the tunnel would be 4 kilometres long and said the route in the report was the one the Authority intends to follow.

The tunnel is budgeted at 620 million Dunmarrow crowns, with a planned build time of six years, according to the figures Ms Ketteridge gave the meeting.

Board members questioned her on the report before the session moved on to other business. Copies of Revision C were available at the meeting for those who wanted to read the full route details.
